nodes.Name: onceError
nodes.DocComment: onceError is an object that will only store an error once.

nodes.Name: ErrClosedPipe
nodes.DocComment: ErrClosedPipe is the error used for read or write operations on a closed pipe.

nodes.Name: pipe
nodes.DocComment: A pipe is the shared pipe structure underlying PipeReader and PipeWriter.

nodes.Name: readCloseError
nodes.DocComment: readCloseError is considered internal to the pipe type.

nodes.Name: writeCloseError
nodes.DocComment: writeCloseError is considered internal to the pipe type.

nodes.Name: PipeReader
nodes.DocComment: A PipeReader is the read half of a pipe.

nodes.Name: Read
nodes.DocComment:
Read implements the standard Read interface:
it reads data from the pipe, blocking until a writer
arrives or the write end is closed.
If the write end is closed with an error, that error is
returned as err; otherwise err is EOF.

nodes.Name: Close
nodes.DocComment:
Close closes the reader; subsequent writes to the
write half of the pipe will return the error [ErrClosedPipe].

nodes.Name: CloseWithError
nodes.DocComment:
CloseWithError closes the reader; subsequent writes
to the write half of the pipe will return the error err.

CloseWithError never overwrites the previous error if it exists
and always returns nil.

nodes.Name: PipeWriter
nodes.DocComment: A PipeWriter is the write half of a pipe.

nodes.Name: Write
nodes.DocComment:
Write implements the standard Write interface:
it writes data to the pipe, blocking until one or more readers
have consumed all the data or the read end is closed.
If the read end is closed with an error, that err is
returned as err; otherwise err is [ErrClosedPipe].

nodes.Name: Close
nodes.DocComment:
Close closes the writer; subsequent reads from the
read half of the pipe will return no bytes and EOF.

nodes.Name: CloseWithError
nodes.DocComment:
CloseWithError closes the writer; subsequent reads from the
read half of the pipe will return no bytes and the error err,
or EOF if err is nil.

CloseWithError never overwrites the previous error if it exists
and always returns nil.

nodes.Name: Pipe
nodes.DocComment:
Pipe creates a synchronous in-memory pipe.
It can be used to connect code expecting an [io.Reader]
with code expecting an [io.Writer].

Reads and Writes on the pipe are matched one to one
except when multiple Reads are needed to consume a single Write.
That is, each Write to the [PipeWriter] blocks until it has satisfied
one or more Reads from the [PipeReader] that fully consume
the written data.
The data is copied directly from the Write to the corresponding
Read (or Reads); there is no internal buffering.

It is safe to call Read and Write in parallel with each other or with Close.
Parallel calls to Read and parallel calls to Write are also safe:
the individual calls will be gated sequentially.
